ai_summary: Acutaas Chemicals Limited announced the re-appointment of Mr. Ram Mohan Lokhande as Whole Time Director and Mrs. Anita Bandyopadhyay as an Independent Director, both for a five-year tenure starting February 2027. This decision ensures leadership continuity and stability, retaining key operational and governance expertise within the company. No red flags were identified, as both directors meet independence criteria and are not debarred, aligning with strong corporate governance practices.
